thread:
andrea: quick async — shipped the kernel prefetch heuristic tweak last night. saw ~6% p99 improvement on smaller models, but a few canary traces are failing with long-seq workloads. putting logs below. blocker: we need a slot-starvation counter in the perf pipeline to correlate these failures. can someone add that metric?

michael: nice work. i saw the same in my local runs. i can add a prometheus counter — question: which label do we use for the slot type? 'slot_kind' or 'batch_slot'? :thumbsup:

andrea: prefer `slot_kind` (more explicit for future alloc strategies). thanks!

jamal: i can wire the metric into the tracing pipeline and add a small dashboard. andrea — can you paste the offending log snippet? need to ensure the exporter parses it.

andrea: here are the logs from the failing trace:

```
2026-07-14T03:12:04Z kernel:prefetch WARN slot_wait_exceeded seq_len=4096 slot_kind=hot_wait duration_ms=1220 trace_id=7f1b2c
2026-07-14T03:12:04Z kernel:alloc DEBUG alloc_attempt slab=false size=65536 shard=12
2026-07-14T03:12:05Z kernel:prefetch ERROR eviction-triggered seq_len=4096 evict_count=3 trace_id=7f1b2c
```

jamal: perfect, thanks. i'll add a `slot_starvation_total{slot_kind="..."}` counter and a parsing regex for that WARN line, then emit a gauge for current waiting slots. will PR to eng-runtime repo and tag @sophia for review.

sophia: happy to review. small nit: include a comment in the prefetch code about saturation thresholds so future readers know the heuristic. also — what's our canary rollout plan for this change?

andrea: rollout plan: enable on pool-7 at 10% traffic, monitor for 30m, then 50% for 1h, then 100% if stable. i'll kick off the canary after metric PR lands.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for kernel/prefetch v2 on pool-7 at 2026-07-14T03:20:20Z (triggered by andrea)

zhen: did a quick microbench (1h) on rtx-24 nodes with the tweak: p50 ~28ms (no change), p95 ~140ms (down ~9%), p99 down ~6%. long-seq tail still has variance but fewer OOM-like evictions. perf dashboard: https://perf.internal/runs/1777

michael: if p99 still flakey for seq>2048, easy mitigation is a runtime toggle to switch allocator strategy: `ALLOC_STRATEGY=slab` for long sequences. we can gate that behind the env so canary can test it.

andrea: good idea — i'll add an env flag to the canary config to try slab for seq>2048 if needed. blocker mostly cleared if jamal + michael can land metric + conf toggle today. i'll open two PRs and link here.

jamal: on it — starting metric PR now, will post link in thread.

sophia: i'll queue review once CI green. quick reminder: avoid changing default allocator behavior on main without feature flag; force it only in canary.

andrea: noted. todays focus: finish metric PR, add env toggle to canary config, run two 30min smoke tests on long-seq, and post perf links. thanks all — coffee time :coffee:
